Not automatically — buying isn't universally better than renting, it depends on your situation.

Buying tends to make more sense if:
- You plan to stay in the same place for at least 5-7 years
- You have a stable income, a down payment saved, and an emergency fund left over after buying
- The monthly cost of owning (mortgage, taxes, insurance, maintenance) fits comfortably in your budget
- You want stability and are okay with less flexibility to move

Renting can be better if you might move soon, want lower upfront costs, or don't want to handle maintenance and market risk.

If you want, tell me how long you plan to stay and roughly how the costs compare, and I can help you think through the trade-offs.
